Title: Firefox and WebKit Playwright executables are not installed
Actual Result: Launch fails before page interaction because executable is absent.
Business Impact: Requested cross-browser exit criterion cannot be evaluated.
Workaround: Install matching Playwright browser binaries on QA host.

Title: Parallel live journeys share gateway and Mailpit test resources
Preconditions: Run live specs with multiple workers
Exact Reproduction Steps: Run gateway and three live flows concurrently.
Expected Result: Independent synthetic tests do not affect each other.
Actual Result: Shared public rate bucket returns 429 and broad mailbox query counts another case's assignment.
UI Evidence: Playwright traces from initial live run
Business Impact: False-negative release signal if live journeys are parallelized.
Workaround: Run live journeys with workers=1 or unique gateway client/mail correlation.

Title: Aggregate cross-browser imports reuse fixed screenshot output paths
Preconditions: Run imported aggregate after screenshot suite
Exact Reproduction Steps: Run qa-09 aggregate with existing screenshot-writing specs.
Expected Result: Evidence files are unique per project/test.
Actual Result: Two Chromium tests completed assertions but failed opening fixed screenshot paths.
State/Data Evidence: Same assertions passed in isolated 152-test regression
Business Impact: False-negative aggregate report; no product impact.
Workaround: Use testInfo.outputPath or unique project suffix.
